display.title: Frankfurter v2 exchange-rate API
display.summary: Query rates from 84 central banks across 201 currencies back to 1948 without an API key, with provider filtering and attribution, time-series downsampling, and streaming output.

documentation.stabilityNote: Read-only public API without authentication. v2 blends multiple central-bank sources; compliance use cases should pin the required official source with the providers parameter.

pricing.summary: The public API is free for commercial use with no monthly or daily quota; upstream rate-limits requests to prevent abuse.
pricing.freeTier: No API key and no API-call fee.
